scope: All 49 surviving result rows from the PropertyAuctions AID 515 grid for the 19 July 2007 Savills Commercial sale. The archived first-party Savills page identifies the sale date, states a total of 49 lots across three catalogue pages and exposes positions 1-20 on page 1. Those first 20 positions reconcile to the secondary grid, including the combined lot label 11-12. The secondary grid exposes 49 unique displayed lot identifiers and reports Offered: 49. Street addresses and postcodes are not exposed and remain null.
completion_scope: all 49 displayed result rows appear exactly once and reconcile to both the first-party total of 49 and the secondary Offered: 49 denominator
